feat(RCLike): add `Continuous.re` and similar (#34419)

This PR adds dot notation for `re`, `im`, `conj` and `ofReal` for `Continuous`, `LipschitzWith` and `Memℓp`.
Given `hf : Continuous f` it allows to use `hf.re` to express `Continuous (fun x ↦ (f x).re)`, similarly to the usual `hf.add hg`.

I also can add the same features for `Summable` but I am not sure where to place them, suggestions are appreciated!

Co-authored-by: ster99 <user@example.org>

feat(Analysis/Normed/Module): real scalars on a complete normed `ℚ`-algebra (#43908)

We show that a complete normed `ℚ`-algebra carries a unique `NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸` structure.

feat(Linter/Multigoal): also lint in conv mode (#45124)

This PR activates the multi-goal linter inside `conv` mode.

Adaptations require replacing uses of `congr` with a focused congruence tactic like `enter`. The only case in which this doesn't work is the `apply_congr` tactic, which unfortunately cannot be replaced with `enter`.

feat(GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/UnitsModPow): add Units.ModPow and API (#44614)

This is a first step toward extending Mathlib's coverage of Selmer groups of rings of S-integers in étale algebras over number fields, ultimately aiming at the Mordell-Weil Theorem for elliptic curves.

We add `Units.ModPow`, an `abbrev` for the quotient of the unit group of a commutative monoid by the subgroup consisting of `n`th powers, together with some basic API, in a new module (and some helper lemmas in other modules, including a few missing `to_additive` attributes).

This is upstreamed from [EllipticCurves](https://github.com/MichaelStollBayreuth/EllipticCurves). The code was originally written by Claude and then reviewed by me.

feat(CategoryTheory): equivalence of categories of elements (#45873)

feat(Algebra/Polynomial/FieldDivision): add mul_add_mod_of_degree_lt and mul_add_div_of_degree_lt (#46275)

also add `Polynomial.add_div` which is the counterpart of [`Polynomial.add_mod`](https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/FieldDivision.html#Polynomial.add_mod) and used in the proof of `mul_add_div_of_degree_lt`.

`Polynomial.add_div` is protected (similar to [`Polynomial.div_eq_zero_iff`](https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/FieldDivision.html#Polynomial.div_eq_zero_iff) because otherwise it would clash with the existing `add_div`.

feat(Analysis/Normed): continuity of `Unitization.toProd` (#46267)

This PR adds a continuity lemma for `Unitization.toProd`. Currently, only the continuity of `fst` and `snd` is proved, but these are syntactic sugar for `.toProd.{fst,snd}`. Since these are compositions, `fun_prop` cannot use these lemmas unless they match the goal exactly.
